defs.zones: behind = beyond the goal line (x > 89); slot = 69..89 ft out, |y| <= 9; high = 54..69, |y| <= 9; circ = 54..89, |y| > 9; pt = x < 54. Shots on goal only (SHOT + GOAL; no empty-net, no shootout).
defs.coords: x_fixed / y_fixed are fixed per team type (home attacks +89, away attacks -89), not per attacker; each shot is rotated 180 deg when it attacks the -89 net (side picked by matching shot_distance), so the attacked net is always at x = +89.
defs.side: L = y > 0 after that rotation (the shooter's left with standard axes); the broadcast orientation cannot be verified from the data, so L/R may be mirrored; the same for players and defenses.
defs.types: secondary_type: wrist, snap, slap, backhand (back), tip-in + deflected (tip), wrap-around (wrap); oth = poke, bat, between-legs, missing.
defs.blend: blended = (cur + w * prior) / (att_cur + w * att_prior), w = k / prior games played; k = 10, k = 2 for a skater whose last-season team differs from his current team; teams / goalies / league k = 10 games. Goalie s = goals allowed % = 1 - save %.
defs.fields: c / tc = current [shots on goal, goals] per zone / per type; p / tp = prior season; w = prior weight; s, d (ts, td) = blended goal % and share of shots; n = effective shots.
